title: Pamingpin Bangsa anu Ditunjuk
intro: Dina mangsa tantangan jeung putus asa anu gedé pikeun hiji umat, hiji janji suci geus dijieun. Jalma ieu, anu mimitina teu dipaliré ku loba jalma, dipilih ku Allah pikeun mingpin hiji bangsa ngalawan musuh anu tangguh. Caritana mangrupa bukti kakuatan iman jeung hikmah di balik tékad suci, nu nunjukkeun yén kapamingpinan anu sajati teu salawasna kapanggih di tempat anu dipiharep.
clues: Abdi dipilih ku Allah janten pamimpin pikeun umat abdi nalika aranjeunna milarian pamingpin pikeun perang di jalan-Na.
Rahayat kuring mimitina mempertanyakan pengangkatan kuring, ngarasa yén batur leuwih pantes kusabab kabeungharan atawa garis keturunanna.
Tanda kapamingpinan kuring anu sah nyaéta mulangna peti suci, anu ngandung barang-barang peninggalan ti nabi-nabi sateuacana, anu mawa katengtreman.
Kuring mingpin pasukan kuring ka walungan, di dinya kuring nguji kataatan maranéhna ku cara ngalarang maranéhna nginum leuwih ti saséndok cai.
Sanajan jumlah jalma anu tetep pageuh sanggeus ujian saeutik, urang tetep nyanghareupan prajurit anu perkasa jeung pasukanana.
Di handapeun komando kuring, saurang nonoman ti pasukan kuring, anu sanés pejuang anu kasohor, kalayan gagah berani ngalawan sareng ngéléhkeun jawara musuh anu tangguh.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
